q31.sampleAnswer:
From: Maria
To: Casey
You’re welcome, Casey. It starts at 1:00 at afternoon, we can go to eat lunch first and go to the art group together. You just need to bring your paintbrushes and thats ok. It cost $238 for it. Can’t wait to see you on Saturday!

keyPoints.descZh: 内容：回答 Casey 的三个问题——美术小组几点开始、需要带什么、要花多少钱
条理性：衔接连贯，使用连接词和衔接手段
语言：词汇和语法结构的准确性与丰富性

anchors.response:
From: Maria
To: Casey
You’re welcome, Casey. It starts at 1:00 at afternoon, we can go to eat lunch first and go to the art group together. You just need to bring your paintbrushes and thats ok. It cost $238 for it. Can’t wait to see you on Saturday!
anchors.noteZh: 所有内容紧扣题目，三个内容要点都表达清楚；使用基本连接词和衔接手段（It, first, and），行文连贯；日常词汇使用恰当（lunch, paintbrushes），熟练运用简单语法结构（It starts at, we can go, You just need to, Can’t wait）；有小错误但不影响理解。内容5/条理性5/语言5。

anchors.response:
From: Edwin
To: Casey
Casey, you need to bring brush, cup and water color. The cost pay is $25. You can start at 25 Jun 2018. You are welcome.
anchors.noteZh: 回答了第二、三个问题，但活动开始时间不明确；只用标点和 and 组织内容；简单语法结构基本正确（You can, You are），基础词汇使用尚可（water color 应为 watercolor 或 watercolour）。内容3/条理性2/语言3。

q31.explanationZh: 满分邮件要回答 Casey 的三个问题：美术小组几点开始、需要带什么、要花多少钱，并用连接词把句子连贯地连起来。

q32.sampleAnswer: There were 2 girls called Adriana and Estella. Both bought tickets to see Luis Miguel sing. But there was a problem. The door to get in was closed. So they have to go by the back door. But they didn’t know that it was the door of Luis Miguel camerino. Then they found Luis Miguel preparing to sing. Finally Luis Miguel invite the girls to sing with him. And all were happy forever.

keyPoints.descZh: 内容：两个女孩去音乐会场馆看歌手演出；歌手在台上为大批观众演唱；两个女孩上台和歌手一起唱歌
条理性：衔接连贯，使用连接词和衔接手段
语言：词汇和语法结构的准确性与丰富性

anchors.response: There were 2 girls called Adriana and Estella. Both bought tickets to see Luis Miguel sing. But there was a problem. The door to get in was closed. So they have to go by the back door. But they didn’t know that it was the door of Luis Miguel camerino. Then they found Luis Miguel preparing to sing. Finally Luis Miguel invite the girls to sing with him. And all were happy forever.
anchors.noteZh: 故事内容紧扣题目要求；使用基本连接词和衔接手段（and, Both, So, it, Then），行文连贯；日常词汇运用大体恰当，熟练运用简单语法结构（There were, there was, they didn’t know that, preparing to）；有小错误但不影响理解。内容5/条理性5/语言5。

anchors.response:
One day, lina and Joslyn is go to the singing malls because they want to see the Fonald Yew to singing the song.

anchors.noteZh: 涵盖了故事全部内容，但语法错误（was go to singing）使第三幅图的描述不太清楚；只用了简单连接词（and, because）；基础词汇使用尚可（One day, the song），简单语法结构水平有限（they want, singing with, they can），错误有时影响理解（After than, their “oppa”）。内容4/条理性3/语言2。

q32.explanationZh: 满分故事要写出三幅图的内容：两个女孩去看歌手的演出、歌手在台上演唱、女孩们上台和歌手一起唱歌，并用连接词把情节连贯地串起来。
